items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: Pete Lyle and I was running the place together.

ctx.x: Remember that? Yeah. And Louis stepped up to play with the band. He had taken a list of the band and it was a cold night. On Sunday night I went there to see the band. Louis was up there and there was a straw hat on. It was freezing. That is mute. Who was that? Louis. Remember when Joe went away?
Well, I'd taken him with me or soon Joe left. He was working with me at Pete Lyle. Pete Lyle and I was running the place together.
That wasn't the place on the array. It was on the labor?

items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: What kind of a place with Pete Lallus?

ctx.x: That was your first job in the city? Mm-hmm.
Yeah. What kind of a place with Pete Lallus? And my brother had a saloon right across from Stouroville in Conta in Claiborne. You know where that... Mm-hmm.
